name: Hezron
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: Now these are the generations of Pharez: Pharez is of Judah, so this is the lineage of Judah, how they came about right down to the king. Pharez begat Hezron, and Hezron begat Ram, and Ram begat Amminadab, and Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon, and Salmon begat Boaz, and Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David.
Pharez begat Hezron, Hezron begat Ram, Ram begat Amminadab, Amminadab begat Nahshon, Nahshon begat Salmon, Salmon begat Boaz, Boaz begat Obed, Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: The line runs from Perez through his sons Hezron and Hamul, and the sons of Zerah are named, five in all.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 2: The Sons of Israel and the Line of Judah

points: Pharez's sons were Hezron and Hamul; Zarah's sons Ethan, Heman, Calcol and Dara were so wise that Solomon's wisdom is measured against them.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: The sons of Hezron are named, and the line is carried through Ram down to Amminadab, Nahshon, Salmon, Boaz, Obed, and Jesse.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 2: The Sons of Israel and the Line of Judah

points: The line of Caleb the son of Hezron is set down through his wives and sons, including Hur, Uri, and Bezaleel.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 2: The Sons of Israel and the Line of Judah

points: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron are named through his wives, including Ram, Onam, Shammai, and Jada.
